verdict.rationale: Calendly documents multi-host sales demo event types and team scheduling, and a community user implies Calendly offers collective events that alternatives lack. Calendar conflict checking is documented, but nothing explicitly states that a collective event shows only slots where every required host is free. missing for 10: first-party documentation of collective event types and their all-hosts-available slot logic, required vs optional host configuration, hands-on corroboration of multi-host availability intersection

support.subject: As a sales lead, I can offer collective events that only show slots when every required host is free

citations.quote: Whether you're booking one-on-one appointments, multi-host sales demos, or group classes, Calendly offers pre-built event types that make scheduling easy for everyone.
Sync your calendars so Calendly can check for conflicts before someone books time.
